contradicting_evidence: Broadly negative participation and negative returns across all observed alt buckets could overwhelm BTC-specific support and produce a more synchronized decline.
The Top-100 tail proxy outperforms BTC relatively, and ETH/BTC improved in the latest hour; persistent follow-through could broaden stabilization. Neither observation currently establishes recovery.
frozen_forecast.expected_path: Uneven stabilization and retests are more supportable than synchronized expansion: BTC benefits from improved settled demand, while ETH and broad alt proxies remain vulnerable to failed rebounds. MIXED denotes cross-asset divergence, not a confident aggregate rise or fall.
falsification_conditions: Sustained BTC and ETH recovery with stronger ETH/BTC, broader positive participation and improving ETH flows would invalidate the divergent outlook toward broad upside.
BTC losing resilience alongside persistent ETH and altcoin weakness would invalidate divergence toward broad downside.
missing_evidence: Whether BTC ETF inflows repeat and whether ETH outflows ease.
Repeated observations demonstrating that relative altcoin resilience becomes positive absolute participation.
A supplied ETH/BTC sequence confirming more than the latest hourly uptick.
supporting_evidence: The latest final ETF session supports BTC selectively: +$526.7 million for BTC against -$103.3 million for ETH.
Large-, mid- and small-alt proxy equal-weight returns are approximately -2.10%, -1.93% and -1.04%; their advancing shares remain only 17%, 22% and 29%.
Stablecoin supply fell 0.29% over 1d and 0.77% over 7d, with deployment unconfirmed, limiting evidence for broad fresh demand.
Although 62 of 100 constituents outperform BTC, only 27 advance. Relative resilience in a declining market does not confirm positive transmission.
